exact_or_approximate: Exact range; kNN reduction discussed, not a GPU kNN evaluation
insert: Route to nearest existing center; append to bucket; full bucket becomes an internal GNAT node.
delete: Remove bucket object directly. Replace deleted internal center, retain old ranges and membership, accumulate replacement-distance tolerance.
partition_representation: Centers, historical Voronoi/hyperplane memberships, ranges and per-center tolerance I_v.
persistence: PARTIAL: old memberships survive center replacement; new insertions follow the new center. This is not one immutable boundary for both generations.
repartition_trigger: Bucket capacity causes local expansion. Rebuild when accumulated tolerance makes queries inefficient is explicitly suggested, not a calibrated implemented trigger.
structural_instability: YES: expensive subtree reconstruction after center deletion is the stated problem.
explicit_stability_goal: YES for avoiding immediate reorganization while retaining exact search; NO claim of quantified GTS sparse-update churn.
nearest_overlap: Retain historical decisions, admit updates locally, widen exact pruning and defer repair until quality degrades.
key_difference: Hyperplane rather than radial quantile partitioning; tolerance reduces pruning; no packed GPU maintenance.
material_caveat: Center identity itself changes. Conclusions call systematic subtree-reconstruction policy study future work.

insert: Follow existing neighbors with bounded arity; add a child and timestamp, update covering radii.
delete: Compare subtree reinsertion, timestamp-ordered reconstruction, and content-free fake nodes. The combined method retains fake nodes until a subtree fake fraction exceeds alpha.
partition_representation: Neighbor objects, insertion timestamps, radii; fake nodes preserve topology but not deleted object content.
persistence: PARTIAL: historical paths survive deferred deletion; pruning must account for insertion history and fake nodes.
repartition_trigger: Combined method rebuilds affected subtree when fake-node fraction exceeds alpha; optimized reconstruction skips unaffected older history.
structural_instability: YES: deletion can change later insertion decisions and degrade search quality.
explicit_stability_goal: YES for sustainable search/update tradeoff; not measured leaf-signature stability.
nearest_overlap: Exact metric history preservation plus an evaluated explicit deferred-repair threshold.
key_difference: Timestamp/neighbor scheme, not fixed GTS quantiles; fake nodes increase traversal.
material_caveat: Rebuild scope may include younger sibling descendants and affected ancestors, not just the deleted node’s descendants. Does not promise zero churn.

exact_or_approximate: Exact under the metric pruning contract
insert: Traverse radial intervals. Insert without redistribution when target leaf has room; otherwise redistribute siblings or split/rebuild selected subtrees.
delete: Remove from leaf; underflow invokes redistribution or merge and possibly root contraction.
partition_representation: Vantage points and ordered radial distance intervals.
persistence: PARTIAL: ordinary updates retain existing decisions; redistribution changes intervals and non-leaf splits invoke subtree construction.
repartition_trigger: Page capacity, ancestor room and minimum occupancy/fanout; root event can be global.
structural_instability: YES: Section 5 explicitly explains parent-to-child split propagation and possible global reorganization.
explicit_stability_goal: YES for limiting substantial restructuring while maintaining balance, not explicit decision leases.
nearest_overlap: The same radial hierarchy already treats decision reuse as the default and structural events as conditional.
key_difference: Redistribution can still alter many memberships; not guaranteed stability across every rebuild.
material_caveat: Deletion of an indexed object is specified. Separate physical erasure/lifetime of an internal VP copy is not fully resolved here; do not assert arbitrary representatives disappear immediately.

exact_or_approximate: Exact queries; coordinate-dependent, not an arbitrary-metric index
insert: Sieve a batch through existing splitters; recurse into balanced subtrees; reconstruct the first subtree that would become unbalanced.
delete: Two rounds: locate actual deletions/discard absent requests, then remove and identify imbalance for selective reconstruction.
partition_representation: Axis splitters, subtree sizes, weight-balanced hierarchy.
persistence: PARTIAL: splitters persist outside explicitly reconstructed subtrees.
repartition_trigger: Each child size must stay within (0.5-alpha) to (0.5+alpha) of parent; violations reconstruct locally.
structural_instability: YES: nested spatial regions prevent ordinary rotations; lazy reconstruction avoids rebuilding after every update.
explicit_stability_goal: YES for amortized update/query balance; no metric-pivot identity objective.
nearest_overlap: Recent parallel preserve-by-default plus thresholded partial reconstruction, with query-quality tradeoff studied.
key_difference: Shared-memory kd-tree, coordinate splitters and cache-efficient batch algorithms, not a GTS CUDA metric tree.
material_caveat: A future parallel/GPU port needs an independent mechanism; batching or physical-layout engineering alone is not sufficient novelty.

data_query_type: LiDAR/coordinate points; nearest neighbor and box operations
exact_or_approximate: Exact search on the maintained set; optional downsampling changes that set
insert: Compare coordinates on existing division axes, append locally; reinsertion clears lazy-delete labels.
delete: Point/box lazy deletion, propagated labels; physically discard invalid nodes during reconstruction.
partition_representation: Point/axis boundaries, subtree sizes, invalid counts and coordinate ranges.
persistence: PARTIAL: existing split planes remain until selective rebuild.
repartition_trigger: Child-size alpha-balance or invalid-node alpha-deleted violation; small rebuild synchronous, large rebuild may use another thread.
structural_instability: YES: small newly acquired frames make whole-tree rebuilding wasteful.
explicit_stability_goal: YES for incremental local maintenance with monitored quality; not formal pivot-decision churn.
nearest_overlap: Sparse mutation, persistent decisions, explicit quality/size signals, selective reconstruction.
key_difference: Coordinate kd-tree; no arbitrary-metric radial decision or GTS physical-plan reuse.
material_caveat: Do not equate exact search after downsampling with exact search over discarded raw points; no cross-GPU speedup imported.

data_query_type: General metric objects; range and kNN
insert: Choose covering/least-enlargement subtree, append to leaf and enlarge necessary radii.
delete: UNCLEAR in this primary article: Section 3.3 explicitly omits deletion due to space; underflow algorithm not provided.
partition_representation: Routing representatives, covering balls, parent distances.
persistence: PARTIAL: representatives and memberships persist on ordinary insertion; bounds can enlarge.
repartition_trigger: Overflow splits a page, promotes representatives and can propagate to root. No periodic global rebuild policy specified.
structural_instability: YES for costly reorganization of static top-down metric trees, not the new GTS churn metric.
explicit_stability_goal: NO dedicated sparse-update partition-identity objective; efficient balanced dynamism is central.
nearest_overlap: Local admission with decision retention between explicit structural events is established.
key_difference: Overlapping ball hierarchy instead of balanced radial quantiles.
material_caveat: No completed insert/delete stability proof from this article; routing object changes at split remain possible.

data_query_type: General metric objects; similarity range search
insert: M-tree path insertion plus update hyper-ring bounds and leaf pivot-distance arrays.
delete: UNCLEAR: full deletion handling, particularly physical deletion of a lifetime pivot, is not specified in the reviewed paper.
partition_representation: M-tree balls intersected with rings around a lifetime-fixed global pivot set.
persistence: PARTIAL: YES for global filter pivots across index lifetime; NO guarantee that local routing/split identities are fixed.
repartition_trigger: M-tree node splitting creates new hyper-ring arrays. No quantified stability/quality-trigger rebuild policy.
explicit_stability_goal: NO; goal is tighter regions and efficient filtering.
nearest_overlap: Fixed/persistent pivot vocabulary and pivot-distance reuse are not new.
key_difference: Filter anchors are not the per-node decisions that choose GTS child memberships.
material_caveat: Do not equate a fixed global pivot set with unchanged tree partition decisions.

insert: ChooseSubtree aims at good occupancy; split overflowing node using MST clustering and group representatives.
delete: UNCLEAR for a full deletion/underflow path in the reviewed paper. Slim-down’s relocation/removal is not a general deletion contract.
partition_representation: Ball representatives and radii, MST split; overlap measured by fat/bloat factors.
persistence: PARTIAL: ordinary insertions retain representatives; splits and quality optimization can redistribute membership.
repartition_trigger: Capacity split; Slim-down postprocess or after a direct descendant split. Quality measures identify room for improvement, not an automatic stable-decision threshold.
nearest_overlap: Local dynamic admission plus explicit quality-driven reorganization.
key_difference: It intentionally moves objects to reduce overlap rather than protecting old partition identity.
material_caveat: The after-split optimization is implemented; other variants are proposals. Do not claim every quality threshold is experimentally calibrated.

data_query_type: General metric objects; similarity range search
exact_or_approximate: Exact metric filtering; similarity is not ANN answer approximation
insert: Section 7.2 proposes downward growth if balance may be violated; implementation/evaluation explicitly future work.
delete: UNCLEAR: Section 9 says efficient insert/delete handling remains open.
partition_representation: Multiple per-node vantage points, equal-cardinality radial partitions, cached pivot distances.
persistence: PARTIAL/proposed: retain VPs and cached distances for reuse during restructuring; not an evaluated dynamic mechanism.
repartition_trigger: Suggested global restructuring when inserted distribution skews the tree; no explicit numerical trigger.
structural_instability: YES: skew under insertion and expensive global restructuring are discussed.
nearest_overlap: Reuse the same vantage points and precomputed distances across restructuring is explicitly anticipated.
key_difference: Static/evaluated bulk structure; dynamic semantics and quality-trigger implementation missing.
material_caveat: Do not label original/extended MVP-tree fully dynamic, or ignore its proposed same-pivot restructuring reuse.

insert: UNCLEAR: reviewed original describes recursive bulk construction, not a dynamic admission algorithm.
delete: UNCLEAR: no complete dynamic deletion mechanism specified.
partition_representation: Split centers, nearest-center domains and pairwise distance ranges.
persistence: UNCLEAR under updates; centers persist only for a built static tree.
repartition_trigger: Recursive build and adaptive degree; no update-trigger rebuild contract.
explicit_stability_goal: NO; goal is reflecting intrinsic geometry and effective pruning.
nearest_overlap: Hierarchical decision representation is antecedent to dynamic GNAT variants.
key_difference: Dynamic guarantees belong to later EGNAT/code, not the 1995 paper.
material_caveat: Occurrences of insert/delete in edit-distance examples do not establish dynamic index updates.

insert: Find a covering parent at a compatible scale; preserve nesting, covering and separation.
delete: Remove occurrences across levels; reparent/promote children to restore covering constraints.
partition_representation: Representatives at discrete scales and cover links; not disjoint quantile partitions.
persistence: PARTIAL: unaffected links survive; deleted representatives require local repairs.
repartition_trigger: Metric invariants immediately dictate repair; no deferred quality-threshold/global rebuild schedule specified.
structural_instability: NO GTS-like sparse-update radial instability characterization.
nearest_overlap: Exact dynamic metric indexing does not inherently require whole-tree rebuilding.
key_difference: Scale-based cover structure, not packed radial partition persistence.
material_caveat: Author project page reports an insertion-pseudocode issue. This card establishes documented operations, not implementation correctness or disputed asymptotic bounds.

data_query_type: Hierarchical clustering/dendrograms, not a query index
exact_or_approximate: Not an exact range/kNN retrieval contract; not identical to full-batch SAHN
insert: Descend nearest child; add a new parent/singleton at the height-distance condition; update visited heights.
partition_representation: Cluster hierarchy, merge heights and proximity measures.
persistence: YES for old hierarchy topology under insertion; heights can change.
repartition_trigger: Insertion creates a node, does not rebuild prior hierarchy; no quality-failure reconstruction threshold specified.
structural_instability: YES: a few added cases can dramatically change the whole dendrogram.
explicit_stability_goal: YES: stability and user comprehensibility are the explicit central goal.
nearest_overlap: Avoiding small-update/large-hierarchy change is established outside exact metric indexing.
key_difference: Clustering-quality objective and insertion-only topology, no exact query or dynamic deletion contract.
material_caveat: Not a same-setting KILL-1 by itself; its quality experiments cannot validate GTS pruning.

exact_or_approximate: Exact kNN over all live components
insert: Buffer and logarithmic carry: combine new/buffer/component points to build selected static trees.
delete: Mark leaf deletions and collapse empty branches; under-half-full components are dismantled and survivors reinserted.
partition_representation: Log-structured static kd-tree components plus a dynamic buffer.
persistence: PARTIAL: untouched component partitions persist; rebuilt components can change all decisions.
repartition_trigger: Capacity/carry on insert; component occupancy below half on delete.
structural_instability: YES for the cost of rebuilding with every batch; no recursive metric-pivot churn measurement.
explicit_stability_goal: NO dedicated identity stability objective; amortized batch maintenance/query tradeoff.
nearest_overlap: Buffered/deferred rebuilding can retain most existing decisions between merges.
key_difference: Multiple query components and merge costs; deferral is not identity preservation through reconstruction.
material_caveat: Logarithmic buffering alone is not a new stable-partition mechanism, and query fanout must be charged.

data_query_type: Motion-planning configuration spaces; GNAT density sampling
exact_or_approximate: GNAT uses a metric, but planner’s evaluated task is sampling/path planning, not an exact search benchmark
insert: Add accepted planning states to the GNAT and planning tree.
delete: UNCLEAR: planner paper does not establish dynamic GNAT deletion.
partition_representation: GNAT branch pivots, child regions/radii and leaf configuration sets.
persistence: PARTIAL: decisions retained between rebuilds; no protection during full reconstruction.
repartition_trigger: Evaluated policy rebuilds from scratch after approximately 10% node-count growth since the previous rebuild. Section III wording is imprecise; this is not total node count greater than 0.1 times the old size.
structural_instability: YES for balance degradation, not leaf-signature churn.
nearest_overlap: Explicit deferred rebuild already appears in a GNAT application.
key_difference: Growth heuristic and whole-structure rebuild, not accumulated stability signal.
material_caveat: This 10% growth policy is not the current OMPL header’s policy; do not mix paper and code versions.

data_query_type: Official GNAT nearest/R/kNN API with a valid metric
exact_or_approximate: Exact metric-pruning API intent; not executed/validated in this task
insert: Route to closest existing pivot, update ranges/radii, append to leaf; split leaf when size exceeds max leaf size and degree.
delete: Cache removals; removing a pivot immediately rebuilds the entire GNAT; cache capacity also triggers full rebuild.
partition_representation: Pivots, per-child distance ranges, radii, leaf data and removed cache.
persistence: PARTIAL: existing pivots/membership survive ordinary updates, not pivot deletion or rebuild.
repartition_trigger: Also rebuild on splitting with cached removals; optional size-based rebalance; re-adding cached object or changing metric can rebuild.
structural_instability: NO explicit sparse-update identity-stability objective in reviewed header.
nearest_overlap: Implemented local admission and conditional deferred repair provide a concrete conceptual control.
key_difference: Full rebuild for deleted pivot; no historical-boundary tolerance as in EGNAT.
material_caveat: Pinned revision 73bd861b15dd7d39129ceecf66b74387d3d84884, not moving docs. Default rebalancing=false; deletion/split cleanup can still rebuild.
